name: lepton-gre
description: A browser-based mathematical field renderer with a Lepton text language and GLSL output.

scripts.test: vitest run tests/expression-syntax.test.ts && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:runtime

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck
